$comment: Every file under tests/purser/ must appear here exactly once, and this file
is enforced by tests/unit/purser-routing.test.js. That guard exists because
these tests were silently inert: 31 files sat in this directory and jest's
testMatch covered only tests/unit and tests/integration, so `npx jest`
discovered ZERO of them. A purser branch that merged contributed dead files,
The root cause was not one missing glob. The purser emitted tests for three
different runners -- node:test, vitest, and jest -- none of which was the one
the repository actually runs for this directory. Routing is therefore
per-file, and anything that cannot run today is quarantined WITH A REASON
rather than left to look like coverage.

runners.node-test: node --test (npm run test:purser) -- assert-based, node:test globals
runners.quarantined: does not execute today; reason is mandatory and audited
runners.helper: imported by other tests; declares none of its own and is never executed directly

mega-volume-test-helpers.js.reason: shared fixture helpers for the node-test files; not a test

test-build-script-rebuild.js.reason: imports { repoRoot } from '../test-utils', which has never existed in any commit on any branch -- broken by construction, never executed

test-concurrency-idempotency.js.reason: imports the nonexistent '../test-utils' repository fixture while probing concurrent build idempotency, so the test cannot initialize

test-edge-cases-paper-epoch.js.reason: imports the nonexistent '../test-utils' repository fixture while probing paper-epoch edge cases, so the test cannot initialize

test-error-handling.js.reason: imports the nonexistent '../test-utils' repository fixture while probing build-script failure handling, so the test cannot initialize

test-rebase-epoch-stability.js.reason: imports the same nonexistent '../test-utils' helper; the behaviour it targets is covered by tests/unit/build-whitepapers.test.js ('paper_epoch equals the maximum source commit author time')

undefined-references.test.js.reason: reads website-v2/public/whitepaper/legible-swarm-whitepaper.pdf.log, a pdflatex build log that is not committed; it can only pass inside the whitepaper-build job, never in unit-tests

whitepaper-figure-validation.test.js.reason: greps a binary PDF as if it were text -- the received value starts '%PDF-1.7' -- so its prose assertions ('outcome ledger') can never match

implementation-status-contracts.test.js.reason: superseded by tests/unit/whitepaper-implementation-status.test.js, and wrong: expects the substring 'BuiltWeak substrate' where the source reads '\BuiltWeak{}' followed by a newline then 'substrate'

whitepaper-metadata.test.js.reason: imports website-v2/src/data/whitePapers.ts; TypeScript cannot load under node --test or the jest purser project. website-v2/src/data/whitePapers.test.ts already covers this under vitest

concurrency-idempotency.test.js.reason: written for vitest and imports apps/relay/src -- belongs in apps/relay, which has its own vitest.config.ts and a relay-tests CI job

cuda-binary-prevention.test.ts.reason: written for vitest and imports apps/fleet-executor/src/sandbox-runner -- belongs in apps/fleet-executor, which has its own vitest.config.ts

changelog-test.ts.reason: written for bun:test -- neither the jest purser project nor node --test can load bun: modules; the bun lane is tests/bun (npm run test:bun) and this file was never wired there

figure-layout-test.ts.reason: written for bun:test (unloadable here) and imports website-v2/scripts/check-figure-layout.mjs, a script that does not exist in any commit -- broken by construction

figure-palette-test.ts.reason: written for bun:test -- jest and node --test cannot load bun: modules; the palette contract it targets is enforced by website-v2/scripts/check-figure-palette.mjs in the website build lane

metadata-validation-test.ts.reason: written for bun:test (unloadable under either runner here) against website-v2/scripts/check-whitepaper-metadata.ts, whose contract runs in the website-v2 lane, not the purser runners

sha256-validation-test.ts.reason: written for bun:test -- bun: modules cannot load under jest or node --test; SHA-256 integrity of the whitepaper artifacts is asserted by tests/purser/whitepaper-hashes.test.js, which does run (jest)

validate-changelog.test.ts.reason: written for vitest and imports '../../src/data/whitePapers' -- a repo-root src/ that does not exist (the module lives in website-v2/src/data) -- authored for a website-v2 test root it never lived in

validate-figure-maturity.test.ts.reason: written for vitest (bare `expect` import from vitest) -- belongs in website-v2, which has its own vitest config; neither purser runner provides vitest globals

validate-figure-palette.test.ts.reason: written for vitest -- belongs in website-v2's vitest suite; the same palette rules are enforced by website-v2/scripts/check-figure-palette.mjs in the website build

validate-metadata.test.ts.reason: written for vitest and imports '../../src/data/whitePapers', which resolves to a nonexistent repo-root src/ -- cannot initialize under any runner wired to tests/purser

validate-sha256.test.ts.reason: written for vitest -- vitest is not a purser runner; committed-artifact hash integrity is already asserted by the routed tests/purser/whitepaper-hashes.test.js
